verdict.rationale: Docusign's own docs describe several in-product AI features that produce insights and suggestions from users' agreement data. AI-Assisted Review flags risky language and suggests redlines, CLM flags non-compliant clauses and suggests approved language, and eSignature offers AI summaries, Q&A and auto-suggested fields. All of this evidence is vendor marketing copy. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of output quality, and detailed docs on portfolio-level insights across many agreements rather than per-document analysis.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
